record.body:
## Rationale

The pick was one answer in an open discussion. Writing it as a phase treated that answer as a plan. The discussion was not finished, so this claim does not adopt the continuation rule.

## Counter-argument

The selected option was an explicit pick, and keeping it as a phase would stop the next session from reopening it. Withdrawing it means the same ground gets covered again once the discussion is actually done.

payload.alternatives: After a phase gate passes, continue into discuss or plan-review; record a close-effort question when nothing remains
payload.choice: Not adopted. Continuation stays in discussion and is not a phase.

record.subject: next-gate-continuation
